subject: Hall B outage — backup power & demo contingency
messages:
From: VenueOps <ops@metroconvention.com>
To: ExhibitorOps, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Intermittent power + degraded Wi‑Fi in Hall B

Hi exhibitors — quick heads up. At 07:58 we had a facility breaker trip impacting part of Hall B; power has been restored but some circuits are unstable and the cached Wi‑Fi controllers are restarting. You may see brief brownouts and packet loss (affecting vendor APs) while our technicians patch the affected feed.

Were prioritizing the main exhibitor corridor but it could take up to 90 minutes for full stability. If you have devices that must remain online (demos, payment terminals), please switch to cellular fallback or request on-site generator support.

Well post updates to the exhibitor Slack and send another email at 08:30.

— Venue Operations
Metro Convention Center
Attachment: metro_floorplan_v3.pdf (hall B circuits marked)

From: Amelia Stone <amelia.stone@cloudverse.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Intermittent power + degraded Wi‑Fi in Hall B

Dylan — were on-site at booth B14. Our live inference demo depends on a persistent web socket to your hosted API and the Cloudverse token refresh flow; if the Wi‑Fi is flakey we lose the demo entirely. Can Redwood help with a last-minute offline fallback or an alternate endpoint we can use?

Were starting the 10:30 customer walkthrough in ~2 hours and would prefer not to cancel.

— Amelia
Amelia Stone, Head of Developer Relations, Cloudverse

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

- Rishi/Monica: can you confirm we have an offline demo bundle (recorded inference + local weights) that Amelia can run from a local laptop if connectivity drops? Monica, can you prepare the step‑by‑-step and staging laptop?
- SoundWorks: please confirm availability to drop a 5kW trailer generator at booth B14 and supply a dedicated 20A feed. If you can provide a quote and ETA well approve immediately. (See attached floorplan for circuit refs.)

Ill also open an emergency API endpoint with pinned model to reduce handshake overhead—engineering will post creds to Slack and Ill DM Amelia once done.

GO — SoundWorks, please dispatch the generator to B14 and send ETA updates to this thread. VenueOps, coordinate placement and waiver signature with the floor manager.

Amelia — Monica will roll a staged laptop with an "offline demo pack" that runs a recorded prompt set and local model bundle; it emulates the production flow and has the same UI so customers still see the product. Monica, link to the package and quick start below and well meet you at the booth in 20 minutes.

Quick start (offline demo):
1) Unzip offline-demo-pack.zip to desktop.
2) Run start.bat / start.sh (starts local inference server on http://localhost:8080).
3) Open demo_local.html in Chrome (works without network).
4) If you need any transcript/recording toggles, use the UI top-right menu.

Attachments: offline-demo-pack.zip (contains start scripts & recorded prompt set)

— Dylan Brooks
Events & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
